# CI/Deploy Release Gate Checklist: Site foundation for doncoleman.ca

**Purpose**: Validate that the spec's and plan's requirements for the automated release gate are complete, unambiguous, consistent and measurable — covering all required test layers before deploy, the local `verify` script mirroring CI, committed screenshot baselines, and the performance budget.
**Created**: 2026-09-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) / [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests the requirements themselves, not the implementation.

## Required Test Layer Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does FR-027's list of required checks (linting, type checks, unit and component tests, E2E, accessibility, build, performance budget) match, item for item, the test layers named in Constitution Principle I, with no layer present in one document and silently absent from the other? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027 vs. Constitution Principle I]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the visual/screenshot-baseline check (FR-005a) explicitly included in the enumerated release-gate checks of FR-027, or does it exist as a separate requirement whose mandatory-gate status is only inferable? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-005a vs. FR-027]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "accessibility checks on every page template in both themes" (FR-027) precise about what counts as a "template" for this feature (placeholder home, not-found, and any shared layout states like the open mobile menu), so coverage is unambiguous at only two real pages? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the contact-API integration test layer (named in Constitution Principle I) explicitly marked not-applicable to this feature's release gate, so its absence from FR-027 isn't mistaken for an oversight? [Consistency, Plan §Constitution Check Principle I]

## Verify-Mirrors-CI Requirements

- [ ] CHK005 Is there a spec- or plan-level requirement that a single local command (`pnpm run verify`) must run the identical set of checks as CI, or is "mirrors CI" only an implementation detail with no traceable requirement/acceptance criterion? [Gap, Traceability, Plan §Constitution Check Principle II]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the acceptance criterion for "mirrors CI" measurable (e.g., same command invoked by both, same pass/fail semantics), or could CI and `verify` diverge (e.g., different browsers, different environments) without violating a stated requirement? [Measurability, Plan §Constitution Check Principle II]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it specified what happens when `verify` passes locally but CI fails (e.g., platform-specific visual baseline differences, explicitly anticipated in the plan's Risks) — is this treated as an expected exception to "mirrors CI" and documented as such in the requirements? [Ambiguity, Plan §Risks "Visual baselines are per-OS"]

## Screenshot Baseline Requirements

- [ ] CHK008 Is the full inventory of required baseline images (header, footer, open mobile menu, not-found page × phone/desktop × dark/light) stated as a complete, closed set matching FR-005a and the plan's "14 shell baseline images per platform," with no discrepancy in count or content between spec and plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005a vs. Plan §Scale/Scope]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the process for updating an *intentionally* changed baseline (vs. an unapproved regression) specified as a requirement (who approves, what command, is it a major change), or left entirely to the plan/tooling with no spec-level acceptance criterion? [Gap, Spec §FR-005a, Constitution Principle III]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "any unapproved difference fails the run" (US1 Acceptance Scenario 7) given a concrete, measurable diff threshold (pixel tolerance, anti-aliasing allowance), or is "unapproved difference" left undefined and therefore potentially flaky? [Measurability, Clarity, Spec §US1 Acceptance Scenario 7]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the reference screenshots of the *current live Ghost site* (FR-005, for Don's manual comparison) kept clearly distinct in the requirements from the *automated* shell baselines (FR-005a), so a reader can't conflate the two different verification mechanisms and their different pass/fail consequences? [Consistency, Clarity, Spec §FR-005 vs. FR-005a]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the cross-platform baseline generation/review workflow (Linux baselines produced via CI artifact, reviewed and committed) captured as an explicit process requirement rather than only as a plan-level risk note, given it directly affects whether the release gate can pass on the first CI run of this feature? [Gap, Plan §Risks "Visual baselines are per-OS"]

## Performance Budget Requirements

- [ ] CHK013 Are all performance budget thresholds (LCP, CLS, plus the plan's additional JS-size/transfer-size/long-task metrics) traceable to a spec-level success criterion, or do some budget dimensions (JS ≤ 10 KB, transfer ≤ 100 KB, long tasks ≤ 200 ms) exist only in the plan with no corresponding spec requirement/SC? [Traceability, Spec §SC-004 vs. Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "simulated mobile device" (SC-004) specified with enough parameters (network throttling profile, CPU throttling factor, viewport) to be reproducible, or does the spec leave simulation conditions entirely to the plan/tooling with no acceptance-level constraint? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004 vs. Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the performance budget required per page template individually (SC-004 says "every page template"), and does the requirement specify what counts as a failing template vs. an aggregate/average pass? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK016 Is there a requirement stating the performance budget check must run against a production-equivalent build (not a dev server), consistent with the plan's choice of `wrangler dev` serving `dist/` rather than `astro preview`? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context Testing, First-party option table "E2E server"]

## Preview & Main-Build Release Flow

- [ ] CHK017 Is "within 10 minutes" (SC-007) for both preview availability and main-build update specified with a clear start event (push timestamp vs. checks-passed timestamp), so the SLA is unambiguous and testable? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK018 Is it specified how a deliberately failing check (SC-008, US3 Independent Test) is distinguished from a flaky/transient failure in the acceptance criteria, to avoid an ambiguous "every time" claim? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the requirement set explicitly forbid re-running or overriding a failed required check to force a merge (per Constitution Principle II "never skipped, disabled or weakened"), and is this reflected as a testable branch-protection requirement rather than only a policy statement? [Gap, Consistency, Spec §FR-030 vs. Constitution Principle II]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the requirement that "the pipeline MUST build on the setup already completed" (FR-031) reconciled with the plan's documented deviation (Workers Builds vs. Wrangler-from-Actions) in a way that's traceable — i.e., does the spec's FR-031 wording anticipate/permit this reconciliation, or does it read as a stricter constraint than the plan actually follows? [Consistency, Traceability, Spec §FR-031 vs. Plan §Deployment reconciliation]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK021 Is SC-011 ("the feature is done when all checks pass in CI... Don has approved") stated with each sub-condition independently verifiable (CI green, preview match, doc committed, main live, PR approved), or could partial satisfaction be ambiguously read as "done"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the major-change label/approval requirement (Constitution Principle III, Plan §Major-change verdict) reflected as a release-gate acceptance criterion in the spec (e.g., within SC-011), so the release gate checklist and the spec's success criteria agree on what blocks merge? [Consistency, Spec §SC-011 vs. Plan §Major-change verdict]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK023 Is the dependency on Cloudflare Workers Builds actually being configured with strict, up-to-date required-status checks on `main` (as asserted in the plan) documented as a verifiable precondition, or only asserted without a corresponding spec/plan acceptance step to confirm it before this feature ships? [Assumption, Dependency, Plan §Deployment reconciliation]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the risk that the non-production deploy command must be manually changed by Don in the Cloudflare dashboard (Plan §Risks, R2) captured as a release-gate precondition/task, given the release gate's canonical-address requirements (FR-017) silently depend on it? [Dependency, Gap, Plan §Risks "Preview address depends on a dashboard change"]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK025 Does "checks may not be skipped or weakened to get a change through" (FR-030) conflict with the plan's explicit statement that "placeholder tests are replaced by stricter-or-equal successors... as a reviewed part of this change," and is the boundary between an acceptable replacement and a forbidden weakening defined anywhere? [Conflict, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-030 vs. Plan §Constitution Check Principle II]
